overview: Migration plan from SolidJS to Vue 3 (Vite). Produce components, routes, Pinia stores, shared types, and CSS design tokens. Keep behavior: fixed GNB, LNB optional, content-only scrolling.

routes.name: Home
routes.notes: Root dashboard; shows workspaces and recent activity

layout.behavior: GNB is fixed at top; LNB is left column but not allowed to scroll vertically; only the content area (right) scrolls. Always show scrollbars on content area for discoverability.
layout.accessibility: GNB uses semantic nav; landmark roles for main/aside/header; keyboard focus order preserved

features: Embedded subviews: Issue main (boards) and Wiki main (pages)
Empty states: when no boards/pages show a clear empty panel like chat
ProjectDetailPage.vue.migrationNotes: Keep server calls but move to Pinia actions or composables. Use route param to set current project ID in store; prefer store-first access for nested components. Keep empty-state behavior implemented in template conditionals.

features: Kanban board view, card lists, drag-and-drop
BoardDetailPage.vue.notes: Use a dedicated composable for board data and optimistic updates. Consider VueUse for debounced saves.

features: WYSIWYG or markdown editor, page list in LNB
PageDetailPage.vue.notes: Port current page rendering; use dynamic import for MD editor to reduce bundle size.

features: Empty-state center screen; room list in LNB; room messages in content
ChatDashboardPage.vue.notes: Existing empty-state looks good; reuse for wiki/issue empty states.

cssConcept.approach: Design tokens (CSS variables) + small utility classes. Scope styles per-component using <style scoped> but keep design tokens global.
layoutRules: header (GNB): fixed height, full width, z-index above content
main area: display:flex; LNB fixed width, content grows and has overflow:auto; hide body scroll (overflow:hidden)
cssConcept.naming: Prefer BEM-like component class names or scoped styles. Keep utility classes minimal (e.g., .flex-between, .btn).

stores.name: boardStore
stores.purpose: boards cache per project, optimistic updates

storeStrategy.typing: Keep shared domain types in src/lib/types.ts (TypeScript). Use types across Pinia stores and components.
storeStrategy.notes: Avoid context patterns; use Pinia for global state. Keep store actions as single source of truth for server interactions.

migrationSteps: Create Vue 3 + Vite skeleton (use pnpm/yarn same package manager as client).
Add Pinia and Vue Router. Create initial App.vue with GNB and RouterView + LNB slot.
Port shared types: copy client/src/lib/types.ts and adjust any Solid-specific types.
Implement `appStore` in Pinia and migrate currentProjectId/currentWorkspaceId usage.
Create Vue single-file components for GNB, LNB, and core pages. Keep component props local; prefer store access for IDs.
Port API layer (axios wrapper) into `client/src/lib/axios.ts` for Vue ecosystem (same axios code is OK).
Migrate pages incrementally: start with ProjectDetailPage, ChatDashboardPage, Board pages. Verify empty states and scroll behavior.
Add CSS variables and a small utility stylesheet. Port `layout.css` rules: body/html overflow hidden, content overflow auto.
Add unit/playground smoke tests by running dev server and verifying routes: /project/:id/issue and /project/:id/wiki empty states show empty panel.
Iterate on interactivity (drag/drop, editor) and lazy-load heavy components.

risksAndMitigations.bundleSize: Large editor or drag-drop libs. Mitigate via lazy-loading and dynamic imports.
risksAndMitigations.behaviorDrift: Subtle differences between Solid reactivity and Vue; create composables that encapsulate business logic and test visually.
risksAndMitigations.styles: Scoped styles may behave differently; centralize tokens to avoid drift.
